class.name: NetwServiceInstallBook
class.brief_description: Which configuration class installs which session service, and how it is taken back out.
class.description: A session installs a typed configuration by looking its class up here, so no one dispatcher has to know every service. Each service's wiring writes its own row at construction, and a service whose row is gone installs nothing rather than installing half of itself. Install and uninstall are one row because they are one service. Held apart, a caller can register an install path and leave no way back, and the session that configured through it can never be deconfigured. A row is found by walking the configuration's script inheritance up to the first registered class, so a subclass of a registered configuration installs through its base's row. [codeblock] book.register_service(&"NetwClockConfig", installer, uninstaller) book.class_of(config) # the registered class it resolves to book.install(config, node) # OK, or ERR_INVALID_PARAMETER [/codeblock]

method.name: class_of
method.description: The registered class [param config] resolves to by walking its script inheritance, or an empty [StringName] when no ancestor is registered.

method.name: has_service
method.description: Whether [param config_class] itself holds a row. This asks about the exact class, where [method class_of] asks what a configuration resolves to.

method.name: install
method.description: Calls the installer registered for [param config]'s class with [param config] and [param object], and answers what it returned. [param object] is the node that registered the configuration, or [code]null[/code] when it was installed by verb. Returns [constant @GlobalScope.ERR_INVALID_PARAMETER] and warns, naming the class, when no ancestor of [param config] is registered.

method.name: register_service
method.description: Registers the pair that installs and uninstalls [param config_class], and answers whether it replaced an earlier row. Both callables take the configuration and the registering object.

method.name: size
method.description: How many configuration classes are registered.

method.name: uninstall
method.description: The paired inverse of [method install], refusing the same way for an unregistered class.

method.name: unregister_service
method.description: Drops [param config_class]'s row, and answers whether there was one. The uninstaller goes with the installer.
